head: SERIF
dzh: 焦糖、咖啡、奶茶一路棕，温暖克制
den: Caramel, coffee and milk-tea browns, warm and restrained
nzh: 整套只用焦糖、咖啡、奶茶、燕麦这一路棕色，深浅拉开层次；点缀色最多一个（橄榄绿或酒红），面积很小；标题用衬线，正文无衬线，留白多显得高级；适合咖啡、秋冬穿搭、家居、香氛
nen: Only the caramel-coffee-milk-tea-oat range of browns, with clear light and dark steps; at most one small accent (olive or wine); serif headings, sans body, generous white space; suits coffee, autumn fashion, home and fragrance
